scope: P1/P2 fixed-checkpoint attribution; no collection, training, tuning, or policy execution

protocol.source: issued t2 from z0..z2; only actual z3 writes source-only support
protocol.root: actual z4,z5,z6, same past controls; independent movement/stop execution
protocol.future: each native prototype freely predicts its own z7..z10; future truth enters scoring only
protocol.A: m dot d = sum_k p_s[k](V_s[k] dot d) - p_f[k](V_f[k] dot d)
protocol.oracle: per root and horizon, slow argmax V_s dot d; fast argmin V_f dot d; shared support across movement and stop
protocol.oracle_selection: offline diagnostic only, never used in likelihoods or deployment
protocol.ties: exact equality, all tied indices retained; deterministic first index for one-hot display
protocol.aggregation: sum numerator / sum truth squared norm, retaining every sign and zero case
protocol.precision: native archived float32 with TF32 off; all evidence and scoring float64
protocol.global_permutation: not computed; per-root signed contributions and cap distinguish orientation without relabeling learned prototypes

validation.forecast_input_boundary: predict_prefix accepts exactly seven actual states z0..z6; no target argument
